headline: Real relief at the pump
dek: The White House says gas prices are plunging ahead of Thanksgiving, just as President Trump predicted, with real relief at the pump and more money in families’ pockets. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: The White House
original.title: Gas Prices Plunge Ahead of Thanksgiving — Just as President Trump Predicted
text: Just as President Donald J. Trump predicted, gas prices are tumbling down — and American families are feeling the relief just in time for Thanksgiving. From coast to coast, prices at the pump are falling fast, with the national average falling to its lowest price in eight months after the biggest three-week dive since 2008. As millions of Americans hit the road to gather with the people they love, President Trump is delivering just what he promised: real relief at the pump and more money in families’ pockets this holiday season.
The drop is being felt across the country:

steve: Gas prices plunge! Lowest in eight months.
This time last year, the same gallon was fifty-three cents cheaper.
*I’m thankful for the plunge. I’m still paying for the climb.*
